summary: Add marketing_opt_in column with DEFAULT FALSE, backfill existing rows to FALSE, deploy new version in state_only mode, retire old version, then apply NOT NULL constraint.
write_consistency: The column DEFAULT FALSE ensures old version INSERTs receive False; backfill sets existing rows; after retire_old, NOT NULL is applied.

stages.description: Add nullable boolean column with DEFAULT FALSE to account_user
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ADD COLUMN marketing_opt_in BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE;

stages.description: Backfill marketing_opt_in to FALSE for all existing rows
sql: UPDATE account_user SET marketing_opt_in = FALSE WHERE marketing_opt_in IS NULL;

stages.description: Set NOT NULL constraint on marketing_opt_in
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ALTER COLUMN marketing_opt_in SET NOT NULL;
